title: 3D Histogram with Categories and Particle Effects
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with a fully interactive 3D histogram visualization using Three.js with particle effects. Load the 'WaterBottle.glb' model using GLTFLoader from a CDN and place it as a decorative trophy on top of the tallest bar.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (12, 10, 12) looking at the origin.
- Add OrbitControls for camera rotation/zoom.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light at (5, 15, 5) with intensity 0.8 and castShadow=true.
- Ground plane: 20x20, gray (#444444), receiveShadow=true.
- Background color: #1a1a2e.

HISTOGRAM BARS:
- Create exactly 6 category bars arranged along the X-axis, spaced 2.0 units apart, centered at origin.
- Categories with initial values: ['Food: 85', 'Tech: 142', 'Health: 67', 'Sports: 110', 'Music: 95', 'Travel: 128']
- Bar width: 1.2, depth: 1.2. Height = value / 20.0 (so Tech=7.1, Travel=6.4, etc.)
- Bar colors in order: #e74c3c, #3498db, #2ecc71, #f39c12, #9b59b6, #1abc9c
- Each bar should have MeshStandardMaterial with metalness=0.3, roughness=0.5.
- Bars sit on the ground plane (y = height/2).
- Add 3D text labels below each bar using a canvas texture on a PlaneGeometry showing the category name.
- Add value labels above each bar showing the numeric value.

WATERBOTTLE MODEL:
- Load WaterBottle.glb and scale it to (3, 3, 3).
- Place it on top of the tallest bar (Tech, index 1). Position Y = bar_height + 0.5.
- The bottle should slowly rotate around Y-axis at 1 radian/sec.

PARTICLE SYSTEM:
- Create a particle system with exactly 500 particles using THREE.Points with BufferGeometry.
- Particles should float upward from each bar like sparks/embers.
- Each particle has random position within bar bounds, random upward velocity (0.5-2.0 units/sec).
- Particles that go above Y=12 should reset to their bar's top.
- Particle color should match the bar they belong from.
- Particle size: 0.08.

INTERACTIONS:
1. HOVER: Raycasting on mouse move. When hovering over a bar, it should glow (emissive = 0x333333) and its particles should speed up 3x. Store hovered bar index in state (-1 if none).
2. CLICK: Clicking a bar selects it. Selected bar raises by 1.0 unit with smooth animation (0.5s). Only one bar selected at a time. Clicking again deselects.
3. KEYBOARD 'R': Randomize all bar values (range 50-150). Animate bars to new heights over 1 second. Update value labels.
4. KEYBOARD 'P': Toggle particle system visibility on/off.
5. KEYBOARD 'S': Sort bars by value (ascending). Bars animate to new X positions over 1 second. Track sort state.
6. KEYBOARD 'T': Toggle between bar chart and cylinder chart (change geometry). Maintain heights and colors.
7. KEYBOARD '1'-'6': Isolate that bar (hide all others with opacity 0.2). Press same key again to show all.
8. DOM BUTTON 'Reset': Reset all values to initial, deselect, unsort, show all bars, show particles.

HUD/UI:
- Top-left: title '3D Category Histogram' in white, 24px font.
- Top-right: display 'Total: {sum}' and 'Average: {avg}' (2 decimal places).
- Bottom: 6 colored squares matching bar colors with category names as a legend.
- A 'Reset' button styled with padding 10px, background #e74c3c, white text, positioned bottom-right.
- A 'Particles: ON/OFF' indicator top-center.

STATE MANAGEMENT - Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- barValues: array of 6 current numeric values
- barHeights: array of 6 current bar heights (value/20)
- selectedBar: index of selected bar (-1 if none)
- hoveredBar: index of hovered bar (-1 if none)
- particlesVisible: boolean
- particleCount: number (500)
- totalValue: sum of all bar values
- averageValue: average of all bar values (2 decimal places)
- sorted: boolean
- sortOrder: array of 6 indices showing current order
- cylinderMode: boolean
- isolatedBar: index of isolated bar (-1 if none)
- bottleLoaded: boolean (true when WaterBottle.glb loaded)
- bottleRotation: current Y rotation of bottle in radians
- animating: boolean (true during any animation)
- barPositionsX: array of 6 current X positions
- frameCount: number incrementing each frame

Update __3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop.
physics_constraints: Particles must obey upward drift velocity 0.5-2.0 units/sec. Bars must maintain height = value/20. Total and average must always be consistent with barValues. Bottle must rotate at ~1 rad/sec. Selected bar offset must be exactly 1.0 unit. All positions must be NaN-free.
